description: This file contains the implementation of BLAS routines for Spark MLlib's vectors and matrices, including operations like axpy, dot, copy, scal, spr, syr, gemm, and gemv, with support for dense and sparse vectors/matrices.

methods.name: javaBLAS
methods.description: Returns the Java BLAS implementation, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: nativeBLAS
methods.description: Returns the native BLAS implementation, falling back to Java BLAS if native is unavailable.

methods.name: getBLAS
methods.description: Selects BLAS implementation based on vector size threshold.

methods.name: axpy
methods.description: Performs y += a * x for vectors, supporting dense and sparse types.

methods.name: dot
methods.description: Computes dot product between vectors, supporting dense and sparse types.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies vector x into vector y.

methods.name: scal
methods.description: Scales vector x by scalar a.

methods.name: spr
methods.description: Adds alpha * v * v^T to a matrix in-place.

methods.name: syr
methods.description: Performs symmetric rank-1 update on matrix A with vector x.

methods.name: gemm
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication C = alpha * A * B + beta * C for dense and sparse matrices.

methods.name: gemv
methods.description: Performs matrix-vector multiplication y = alpha * A * x + beta * y for various matrix and vector types.
